PRESS RELEASE ON CONSUMER PRICE INDEX (CPI) INFLATION
FOR THE MONTH OF SEPTEMBER, 2026
Base Year
Indicators
2015-16 (%)
Inflation Rate, September, 2026 over August, 2026 (Month on Month) 1.27
Inflation Rate, September, 2026 over September, 2025 (Year on Year) 10.26
Average Inflation Rate, July- September, 2026-27 over July-September, 2025-26 10.20
Analysis of Consumer Price Index (CPI) Base Year (2015-16)
1. The CPI for base year (2015-16) comprises of urban and rural CPIs. The Urban CPI covers
35 cities and 356 consumer items. The Rural CPI covers 27 Rural Centers and 244 consumer items.
The National CPI for 12 major groups is also computed by taking weighted average of Urban and
Rural CPIs.
Monthly Analysis [September, 2026 over August, 2026]
2. CPI National for the month of September, 2026 increased by 1.27% over August, 2026. The
Urban CPI recorded an increase of 1.31% while Rural CPI recorded an increase of 1.23% on MoM
basis.

YEARLY ANALYSIS [September, 2026 over September, 2025]
4. CPI National for the month of September, 2026 increased by 10.26% over September,
2025. The Urban CPI increased by 10.12% while Rural CPI increased by 10.47% on YoY basis.

PERIOD - AVERAGE INFLATION RATE [July-September, 2026-27 over July-September, 2025-
26]
6. CPI National for the period July-September (2026-27) increased by 10.20% over July-
September (2025-26). The Urban CPI recorded an increase of 9.76% while Rural CPI recorded an
increase of 10.86%.
